# El Cap Restaurant

> Hamburger Restaurant in St. Petersburg, Florida. Burgers, fries, tator tots and beer at the bar. Open daily from 11 AM.

- Phone: (727) 521-1314
- Address: 3500 4th St N, St. Petersburg, FL 33704
- Areas: St. Petersburg, Gulfport, Pinellas Park, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island
- Offers: Cheeseburgers; Fries and tator tots; A burger and a beer
- Rating: 4.4 from 3476 Google reviews
